Step: Add 9 months to 1355-05-18 → 1356-02-18 (since 5 + 9 = 14 months → 1 year 2 months).  
Then add 25 days → 1356-03-14 (Feb has 29 days in 1356 because 1356 is a leap year under Gregorian rules? Actually Gregorian starts 1582, but we use proleptic Gregorian: 1356 divisible by 4 and not by 100 → leap year).  
Feb 18 + 25 days = Feb 29 (12 days) + 13 days = Mar 14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1356-03-14
